kutular.kural: pooled quintiles of the drawn cells (20/40/60/80 %), inner edges rounded to 0.05, outer edges the data range rounded outward to 0.1

notlar: Group labels name groups, not models; the model order inside each group follows modeller_ortak (cizilen.<set>.sira).

ImageNetV2 cell table labels transformers 'V-scr' and CNN counterparts 'C1-R32' (frozen script reuse); shown as 'transformer' and 'CNN (pair)'. CIFAR-100 'V-scr'/'C1-R32' are shown as 'ViT (C100)' and 'ResNet (C100)' (konsey m15).
kararlar: Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the bin edges are the pooled quintiles of the drawn cells (rounded to 0.05) instead of five equal steps, because equal steps put 104 of CIFAR-10's 190 cells into one step and hid the within-block gradation; the step count stays five, because the style supplies five ramp tones (isi_1..isi_5) and a sixth or seventh tone would be a colour the palette does not hold.
Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the undefined diagonal is filled dark grey (the style's muted ink), because white sat next to the lightest step (#EAEAF2) and could not be told apart.

Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the ramp stays the style's blue isi ramp, because a non-blue ramp would need new tones outside style 7; the caption must say the blue ramp is not the ResNet (R224) colour (Faz C).

Karar: the continuous cividis map of the council draft became the style's five-step one-hue ramp (isi_1..isi_5), because the skill's heat-map rule asks for five steps of one hue and the style supplies them; the bin edges come from the data range (kutular).
Karar: white cards for the heat maps, because the lightest ramp step equals the style's grey plot-area tone and would merge with a grey card.
Karar: only rows are labelled, because every matrix is symmetric (checked, max |T - T^T| = 0) and column labels would cost the height ceiling (70 mm).
Veri alani payi does not apply: a heat map has no value axis (plan 9.8).
